summary.text: Bill Driscoll is a Democratic state senator representing the Norfolk, Plymouth, and Bristol District, in office since January 2025, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election. Ballotpedia lists him as William Driscoll Jr.
He previously served in the Massachusetts House of Representatives from 2017 to 2025.

paragraphs.text: William Driscoll Jr. earned a bachelor's degree in communications from Boston College in 2005.
His career experience includes more than a decade working in the disaster response and humanitarian aid sector.
Driscoll represented the 7th Norfolk District in the Massachusetts House of Representatives from 2017 to 2025 and assumed office in the State Senate on January 1, 2025, succeeding Walter Timilty.

In the 2025-2026 session he chaired the Joint Committee on Public Health and was vice chair of the Joint Committee on Consumer Protection and Professional Licensure and the Joint Committee on Public Safety and Homeland Security.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
